name: Dream Queen
summary: **Dream Queen** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] from [[breeder:Humboldt Seed Company]], a three-way cross of [[green-crack|Green Crack]], [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]], and [[mazar-star|Mazar Star]]. The breeder stabilized it through two generations of selfing (S2).

sources.title: Dream Queen (Humboldt Seed Company)
sources.note: L1-C audit 2026-09-25: gives Humboldt Seed Company, Green Crack x Skunk #1 x Mazar Star, and S2 stabilization.
